results.evidence: The approach, variant, itinerary and waypoints all use the Heliotrope Ridge/Hogsback camp (~6,000 ft). The bivy list (Park Glacier camp near the Portals, Camp Kiser on Ptarmigan Ridge) serves the Park Glacier Headwall from Artist Point, not this route; the hidden 'Heliotrope Ridge Camp' is the one that serves it. Bivy is owned by the camping clean-up — no patch.

The 'Heliotrope Ridge Trailhead' pin and approach_logistics.trailheadLat/Lng (48.8465, -121.6927) are the Artist Point coordinates; the sibling North Ridge row stores the Heliotrope Ridge trailhead at 48.80201, -121.89597. Coordinates are out of scope for this pass, so the pin needs a coordinate repair elsewhere.

Trailhead (~3,700 ft) to the Hogsback camp (~6,000 ft) is about 2,300 ft, which the sibling Coleman-Deming and North Ridge approaches state. But changing the day to 2,300 makes the itinerary total 6,900 against gain_ft 7,201 (it is 7,500 now), and the rules forbid changing a day's figure unless the total then equals gain_ft or a source states both. A sourced car-to-car gain for the Cockscomb would settle day 1, day 2 and gain_ft together.

A trail listing puts the Ptarmigan Ridge Trail's highest point at 6,100 ft and says the trail then drops slightly before the nondescript Camp Kiser, so ~7,000 ft looks too high, but no page states Camp Kiser's own elevation (the Forest Service route page, trip reports and a glacier study all name it without a height). A topo-derived height for Camp Kiser would settle it.
